posts.meta_description:
vishaldadlani on October 15, 2026: "India lost a true LEGEND today. Every single rockandroller since #RockMachine owes @sheeshling (Mahesh Tinaikar) a debt of gratitude for lighting up the way that we couldn’t even imagine until they walked it! 

An inspiring and pioneering musician, and a guy who always stood on the right side of things. Grateful I got to be on stage with @induscreednow and say thanks to all of them in public. 

I feel like I’ve been kicked hard in the chest, so I can’t even begin to imagine what @udaybenegal @markselwyn1 @zubinbalaporia #JayeshGandhi and of course @shantanuhudlikar and @farhad.wadia are feeling right now. 

My deepest condolences to all of them, to Mahesh’s family and to Music!".
